body: A wound around adequacy, often tied to the body or health: a feeling of being flawed or never quite good enough.
business: You become a skilled healer, editor, or fixer who meets people where they are imperfect.
shadow: Relentless self-criticism, or fixing others to avoid your own wound.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
